name: Shiga Asatsuki
source:
Faction: Taimanin
Skill: Ninjutsu: Falcon Tecnique (Ninpou: Hayabusa no Jutsu), Ninjutsu: Light Blade Blossom [Pair] (Ninpou: Hikari Ki Hana [Sou]), Ninjutsu: Shining Violent Flowe (Ninpou: Hikari Retsu Hana), Ninjutsu: Black Blade of Disaster
Artist: [url=/s711]ZOL[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/97bc3e269840a2c5dabf9b71a12e3927.png]TM 3 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/a0eda77a97aed868f26ecff26e534404.png]TM 2 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/da46b6234abeccfce864fd0428b0083e.png]TM 4 Stars EX[/url]
History:
Coming from an ordinary Taimanin family that was distantly related to the Igawa clan. She became a weaker Taimanin herself, but on a mission was seriously hurt and almost died.
Revived only by [url=/c29638]Kiryuu Sabato[/url]'s medical technology when he still worked by Nomad, her body that was structure wise similar to Asagi and was infused with blood and genes of .[url=/c66507]Igawa Asagi[/url] At that time, the majority of her body was supplemented with Asagi's genes, in addition to the skeletal structure of her body, the abilities of her body have become even more similar to Asagi. She was the only survivor of those experiments and was later found by Igawa Asagi herself, that was raiding some of Kiryuu's labs. Returning to Gosha Village, they realized that her facial features body, hair and even movements became identical to those of Asagi.
Asatsuki joined the Taimanin elites but requires a visor to use her new abilities.
Since then, she is getting confused with Asagi and suffers from mental issues as part of her personality seems to be effected.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Shiga_Asatsuki]breezewiki.com[/url]]
